key_observations: LP signal is effectively dead for zero-shot: rho=0.081 (SciERC), rho=-0.002 (CoNLL). LP selection hurts both datasets.
VC is the strongest signal on SciERC (0.277); SJ is strongest on CoNLL (0.304). All non-LP signals cluster in 0.18-0.30 range.
Greedy F1 is substantially lower than fine-tuned 7B on SciERC (0.40 vs ~0.55+), but CoNLL is competitive (0.71).
Oracle headroom is large: SciERC 14.96pp, CoNLL 5.31pp. Room for improvement exists but LP cannot capture it.
No aggregation method reliably beats greedy. MV gives +1.4pp on SciERC but -0.9pp on CoNLL.
Degeneracy data not present in signal report; would need separate computation from samples.jsonl.
